home.title: Physical E-Commerce Protected by Smart-Contract Escrow.
home.subtitle: Every product is backed by an on-chain NFT certificate. Payments remain locked in escrow until the buyer confirms physical receipt. Zero fraud, zero chargebacks, zero on-chain personal data.
home.howItWorksDesc: Live demonstration of our 4-stage smart contract settlement lifecycle.
home.featuredDesc: Verified physical items with decentralized IPFS metadata.
home.escrowDesc: Buyer funds are held autonomously in the Escrow.sol contract until delivery confirmation. Sellers cannot run with funds; buyers cannot falsely claim non-receipt.
home.nftDesc: Each item carries an immutable ERC-721 token on Ethereum. When delivery completes, token ownership automatically transfers to the buyer as permanent proof of authenticity.
home.privacyDesc: Personal data—names, home delivery addresses, and private tracking codes—remain strictly off-chain in PostgreSQL. The public blockchain only handles financial settlement.
